description: This file defines the NotesRepository class, providing an API for CRUD operations on notes, interfacing with a database helper. It facilitates creating, updating, deleting, retrieving, and searching notes.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: A repository class encapsulating database operations for notes, providing methods to create, update, delete, retrieve, and search notes.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with the provided title and content. Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content. Returns true if the update was successful.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID. Returns true if a note was deleted.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by last update time descending.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Searches notes by a query string matching title or content.
